title: FramesManifestSchema
description: Output contract for the Capture stage (companion to TranscriptSchema). Lists every captured frame in playback order.

frames.description: Playback-ordered list of captured JPEG frames. May be empty if no frames were captured.

timestamp_ms.description: Playback position in milliseconds when this frame was captured.

file_path.description: Relative path (from cache root) to the JPEG file for this frame.
